correctness.rationale: For finite nonempty comparability-connected poset P of cardinality n, nonalgebraic types are ideal/filter pairs (L,U) with every l in L below every u in U. A minimal or maximal extreme vertex z whose deletion preserves comparability-connectedness exists via leaf block of the finite block-cut tree. For maximal z with nonempty B={q<z}, extension criteria give exactly one triple-extension type and an unavoidable single-extension type, all others at most two, proving t(P)<=2t(P-z). Equality forces B a unique minimum of Q and Q\{b} antichain (or the dual), hence star. Induction from n=1 yields t(P)<=3*2^(n-1), equality exactly ordinal-sum bottom-star or top-star including singleton and n=2 chain. Independently enumerated all naturally labeled transitive posets through n=5 and checked 1,1,3,18,181 connected instances respectively, sharpness/equality and count conditions; this is finite support to the structural proof, not exhaustive all n.
